abilities.name: Aspect of the Beast
abilities.desc: You take on the aspects of a beast, becoming untrackable and increasing Melee Attack Power by 110. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Cheetah
abilities.desc: The hunter takes on the aspects of a cheetah, increasing movement speed by 30%. If the hunter takes damage, he will be dazed for 4 sec. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Hawk
abilities.desc: The hunter takes on the aspects of a hawk, increasing Ranged Attack Power by 120. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Monkey
abilities.desc: The hunter takes on the aspects of a monkey, increasing chance to dodge by 8%. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Pack
abilities.desc: The hunter and group members within 30 yards take on the aspects of a pack of cheetahs, increasing movement speed by 30%. If a pack member takes damage, they will be dazed for 4 sec. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Wild
abilities.desc: The hunter and all party and raid members within 30 yards take on the aspect of the wild, increasing Nature resistance by 60. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Beast Lore
abilities.desc: Gather information about the target beast. The tooltip will display damage, health, armor, any special resistances, and diet.

abilities.name: Bestial Wrath
abilities.desc: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.

abilities.name: Call Pet
abilities.desc: Summons your pet to you.

abilities.name: Dismiss Pet
abilities.desc: Dismiss your pet. Dismissing your pet will reduce its happiness by 50.

abilities.name: Eagle Eye
abilities.desc: Zooms in the hunter's vision. Only usable outdoors. Lasts 1 min.

abilities.name: Eyes of the Beast
abilities.desc: Take direct control of your pet and see through its eyes for 2 min.

abilities.name: Feed Pet
abilities.desc: Feed your pet the selected item. Feeding your pet increases happiness. Using food close to the pet's level will have a better result.

abilities.name: Intimidation
abilities.desc: Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.

abilities.name: Mend Pet
abilities.desc: Heals your pet 245 health every second while you focus. Lasts 5 sec.

abilities.name: Revive Pet
abilities.desc: Revive your pet, returning it to life with 15% of its health.

abilities.name: Scare Beast
abilities.desc: Scares a beast, causing it to run in fear for up to 20 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one beast can be feared at a time.

abilities.name: Summon Hawk
abilities.desc: Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing 108 plus 5% of your Ranged Attack Power Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.

abilities.name: Tame Beast
abilities.desc: Begins taming a beast to be your companion. Your armor is reduced by 100% while you focus on taming the beast for 20 sec. If you lose the beast's attention for any reason, the taming process will fail. Once tamed, the beast will be very unhappy and disloyal. Try feeding the pet immediately to make it happy.

abilities.name: Tranquilizing Shot
abilities.desc: Attempts to remove 1 Frenzy effect from an enemy creature.

abilities.name: Aimed Shot
abilities.desc: An aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 166. Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot.

abilities.name: Arcane Shot
abilities.desc: An instant shot that causes 217 Arcane damage.

abilities.name: Auto Shot
abilities.desc: Automatically shoots the target until cancelled.

abilities.name: Concussive Shot
abilities.desc: Dazes the target, slowing movement speed by 50% for 4 sec.

abilities.name: Distracting Shot
abilities.desc: Distract the target, causing threat. More effective than Distracting Shot (Rank 5).

abilities.name: Enchanted Flare
abilities.desc: Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within 10 yards of the targeted area, and staves off magical darkness for 30 sec.

abilities.name: Flare
abilities.desc: Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within 10 yards of the targeted area for 30 sec.

abilities.name: Hunter's Mark
abilities.desc: Places the Hunter's Mark on the target, increasing the Ranged Attack Power of all attackers against that target by 143. In addition, the target of this ability can always be seen by the hunter whether it stealths or turns invisible. The target also appears on the mini-map. Lasts for 2 min.

abilities.name: Multi-Shot
abilities.desc: Fires several missiles, hitting 3 targets. Multi-Shot shares its cooldown with Aimed Shot.

abilities.name: Rapid Fire
abilities.desc: Increases ranged and melee attack speed by 40% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Scatter Shot
abilities.desc: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.

abilities.name: Scorpid Sting
abilities.desc: Stings the target, reducing the target's chance to hit with attacks by 2% for 20 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Serpent Sting
abilities.desc: Stings the target, causing 555 Nature damage over 15 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Sniper Shot
abilities.desc: A long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 295 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Trueshot Aura
abilities.desc: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party or raid members within 45 yards by 50. Lasts 30 min.

abilities.name: Viper Sting
abilities.desc: Stings the target, draining 1,108 mana over 8 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Volley
abilities.desc: Continuously fires a volley of ammo at the target area, causing 112 Arcane damage to enemy targets within 8 yards every 1 sec for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Counterattack
abilities.desc: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 55 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

abilities.name: Deterrence
abilities.desc: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Disengage
abilities.desc: Attempts to disengage from the target by reducing threat. More effective than Disengage (Rank 2). Disables auto-attack.

abilities.name: Explosive Trap
abilities.desc: Place a Fire trap that explodes when an enemy approaches, causing 208 to 264 Fire damage and 330 additional Fire damage over 20 sec to all within 10 yards. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Fire trap can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Feign Death
abilities.desc: Feign death which may trick enemies into ignoring you. Lasts 6 min. If not cancelled, after 6 min you will actually die.

abilities.name: Freezing Trap
abilities.desc: Place a Frost trap that freezes the first enemy that approaches, preventing all action for up to 20 sec. Any damage caused will break the ice. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Frost trap can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Frost Trap
abilities.desc: Place a Frost trap that creates an ice slick around itself for 30 sec when the first enemy approaches it. All enemies within 10 yards will be slowed by 60% while in the area of effect. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Frost trap can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Immolation Trap
abilities.desc: Place a Fire trap that will burn the first enemy to approach for 690 Fire damage over 15 sec. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Fire trap can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Lacerate
abilities.desc: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 406 damage over 21 sec.

abilities.name: Mongoose Bite
abilities.desc: Counterattack the enemy for melee weapon damage plus 57. Can only be performed after you dodge.

abilities.name: Raptor Strike
abilities.desc: A strong attack that deals melee weapon damage plus 70.

abilities.name: Strider Kick
abilities.desc: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Track Beasts
abilities.desc: Shows the location of all nearby beasts on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Track Demons
abilities.desc: Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Track Dragonkin
abilities.desc: Shows the location of all nearby dragonkin on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Track Elementals
abilities.desc: Shows the location of all nearby elementals on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Track Giants
abilities.desc: Shows the location of all nearby giants on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Track Hidden
abilities.desc: Increases stealth detection and shows hidden units within detection range on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Track Humanoids
abilities.desc: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Track Undead
abilities.desc: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Wing Clip
abilities.desc: Inflicts 50 damage and reduces the enemy target's movement speed by 60% for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Throw
abilities.desc: Hurl a thrown weapon at the target.

abilities.name: Beast Training
abilities.desc: Lets you train your pet with various abilities that you have learned how to teach.

abilities.name: Blood Fury
abilities.desc: Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Shatter Curse
abilities.desc: Instantly removes all Curses and Banes, and reduces all Magical damage taken by 5% for 8 sec.

abilities.name: War Stomp
abilities.desc: Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 2 sec.

abilities.name: Cultivation
abilities.desc: Cultivate a nearby herb, growing a duplicate you can harvest without requiring Herbalism skill. Each herb may only be cultivated once. In play it goes on a 15 min cooldown, though its tooltip shows none.

abilities.name: Berserking
abilities.desc: Increases your spellcasting and attack speed by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Rapid Regeneration
abilities.desc: Regenerate 50% of your maximum Health over 6 sec. Any movement, action, or damage taken will cancel the effect.

abilities.name: Walk on Air
abilities.desc: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

abilities.name: Skysight
abilities.desc: Increases your movement speed by 15% for 15 sec. Used at an elemental convergence it also grants Charged for 1 hour, which raises the bonus to 30%. Charged persists through death and ends when you enter a raid.

abilities.name: Perception
abilities.desc: Dramatically increases stealth detection for 20 sec.

abilities.name: Will to Survive
abilities.desc: Instantly removes all Stun effects.

abilities.name: Find Treasure
abilities.desc: Allows the dwarf to sense nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap.  Lasts until canceled.

abilities.name: Stoneform
abilities.desc: Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.

abilities.name: Shadowmeld
abilities.desc: Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Using this ability in combat discourages enemies from attacking you, but increases the cooldown to 2 min.

abilities.name: Elune's Light
abilities.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Walk on Air
abilities.desc: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

abilities.name: Read Leyline
abilities.desc: Increases your Health and Mana regeneration by 50% for 15 sec. Used at a Ley Line it also grants Attuned for 1 hour, which raises the bonus to 100%. Attuned persists through death and ends when you enter a raid. Cannot be used while Innervate is active.
